quickVerdict.title: Quick verdict
quickVerdict.body: Need to combine several references or change an existing clip? Omni Flash 1.1 accepts up to 10 reference images and supports editing, extension and conversational refinement. Veo 3.1 accepts up to 3 reference images; its source-video workflow extends a clip rather than editing it. For a new shot from text or an image, both are options: compare the examples and the price at your chosen resolution. Both offer 4K and native audio.
